text_block_list.text:
Merely announcing her debut created a 
massive buzz for the "Emperor," Symboli 
Rudolf. Yet, she remains completely calm 
and collected amidst the public's 
expectations.

She spoke with eloquence. Setting her 
sights on the Classic Triple Crown, she 
declared she would claim even more titles 
to prove herself as the true "Emperor."

And at the dawn of it all, a grand 
challenge began, aiming for "a world where 
all Umamusume can live happily"!
